title: did-types: render PlcState as a DID document
description: verify_plc_audit_log (JMAP-6itf.5) returns PlcState in the /data shape. did:plc v0.3.0 §Presentation as DID Document defines how that state renders as a DID document (@context, alsoKnownAs, Multikey verificationMethod '#<id>', service '#<id>' with serviceEndpoint).
